objective: Keep the teacher PPT narration UI usable when the signed server workflow returns partial production-readiness status before step details or download links exist.

behavior.before: A partial /api/ai/teacher-ppt-workflow response without workflow.steps could crash the teacher workflow panel before the teacher saw production-readiness progress.
behavior.after: The teacher workflow panel now renders workflow status and readiness progress, shows explicit empty states for missing server steps and download entry points, and preserves existing per-slide WAV download behavior when downloads are ready.
